Silent,Ⓒa.ⒹtURIka, anAlApin, mUka, mO-nin, niHSabda, nIrava.

 2 rudDa-badDa-muKa, ni-ruttara, anuttara; ‘habitually s(ilent)’ tuzRIMSIla, alpaBAzin, vAgyata, vAcaMyama; ‘when the lute was s(ilent)’ vIRAyAM mUkIBUtAyAM; ‘become or remain s(ilent)’ (after speaking) upaSam 4 P, viram 1 P; evamuktvA u-paSaSAma, upaSAMtavacasi tasmin &c.
Ⓝ[Silent]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹtUzRIM, jozaM, niHSabdaM, niBftaM, mOnI-BUya.
ⓃSilence,Ⓒs.ⒹmOnaM, mUkaBAvaH, niHSabdatA; anAlApaH, tUzRIMBAvaH, aBAzaRaM; ‘keeping s(ilence)’ vAkstaMBaH-roDaH-yamanaM, muKa-baMDanaM; ‘one who holds s(ilence)’ vAcaMyamaH, mOnavratin m.; ‘keep s(ilence)’ tUzRIM-jozaM-As 2 A or sTA 1 P; mOnaM AsTA-Baj 1 A, vAcaM yam 1 P or niruD 7 U, muKaM baMD 9 P.
Ⓑ
 2 pra-, SAMti f., stimitatA; ‘in the s(ilence) of night’ praSAMtAyAM rAtrO.
Ⓔinterj.ⒹtUzRIM Bava, mOnaM kuru.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹmOnaM laB c. (laMBayati) or avalaMb c., viram c., pra-upa-Sam c.

 2 niruttarIkf 8 U, aDarIkf, muKaM baMD.
Ⓝ[Silenc]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓniruttara, anuttara, niruttarIkfta, rudDa-badDa-muKa.

Silk,Ⓒs.ⒹkOSeyaM, kOSaM, kIwasUtraM; pawwaH, kzOmaM, dukUlaM, kOSAMbaraM, kOSikaM (‘s(ilk)-cloth’); ‘China s(ilk)’ cInAMSukaM; ‘bleached s(ilk)’ patrorRaM, DOtakOSeyaM; ‘s(ilk)-cotton tree’ SA-lmaliH-laH, SAlmalivfkzaH, picCilA; ‘s(ilk) worm’ koSa(za)kAraH, pawwakIwaH, taMtu-kIwaH-kfmiH, koSasTaH.
Ⓝ[Silk]en,Ⓒa.ⒹkOSeya (yI f.), kzOma (mI f.), kOSika (kI f.), kOSa (SI f.); ‘s(ilken)-cloth’ dukUlaM, kO-SAMbaraM, kzOmaM, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 mfdu, komala.
Silly,Ⓒa.ⒹmUrKa, bAliSa, mUQa, alpaDI-mati, durmati, nirbudDi; See Foolish; ‘what a s(illy) boy’ aho mUQo bAlakaH.
Silt,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(up) avaruD 7 U, avazwaMB 9 P.
Silvan,Ⓒa.Ⓓvana in comp., vanya, vanasTa, araRyaja; ‘s(ilvan) goddess’ vanadevatA; ‘s(ilvan) scenery’ vanaSoBA-SrIH.

Silver,Ⓒs.ⒹrUpyaM, rajataM, SvetaM, durvarRaM, KarjUraM, kalaDOtaM; ‘s(ilver) leaf’ rUpyapatraM ‘s(ilver)-smith’ rUpyakAraH, svarRakAraH. ‘Silver wedding’, s. paMcaviSA vivAha-tiTiH.
